items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Bechat (PHONETIC) had left us and gone somewhere.

ctx.x: Now, tell me, after you guys -- you told me how Ivie Anderson joined the band. How did Johnny Hodges come into the band?

Johnny was playing with Chick Webb at the Savoy. And Bechat (PHONETIC) had left us and gone somewhere. So Duke got -- he heard about Johnny so he offered Johnny a job. Johnny was with Chick Webb and Cootie was with Chick Webb. So Duke liked Johnny Hodges and he offered him more money than he made with Chick, and a steady job. So he picked up with him.
Boy, I liked this book. This was when we got to Europe.
